status: Five text-free Level2.1 HUD proposals; pending selection, not integrated

entries.title: Rope and corks
entries.prompt: Create an in-game-style UI concept using attached historical Level2.1 gameplay screenshot as background reference. Preserve ride watercourse, ramp and Sean riding scene as closely as possible. Remove OS window titlebar/sharingbutton and bottom debug controls; game scene fills landscapeframe. Replace only top-right health/lives area with described unique compact HUD; preserve left level title/instructions. NO TEXT OR LETTERING ANYWHERE IN HEALTH/LIVES COMPONENT: no SEAN,TONY,HP,LIVES, numerals, logos, decorative pseudo-writing. Five discrete health tokens: four active and fifth visibly broken/depleted; separate group of exactly THREE Sean portrait life tokens. Sean bald with gray goatee and orange shirt/blue overalls Normal outfit. No extra portrait. Fit within current topheader, never obscure gameplay. Detailed whimsical plumbing game art, crisp readable atnormalgameplaysize. This is illustrative concept not actual runtime. Design: Nautical rope stretched horizontally, five chunky cork floats along upper rope as health, four intact teal-tipped and fifth split dark; three oval cork medallions containing Sean portraits tied below for lives. Natural tan rope, wet cork, tiny brass knots; no machinery box.
